newsitem.title: USA: Scherer sees '97 eps cut by strong dollar.
newsitem.headline: Scherer sees '97 eps cut by strong dollar.

text.p: R.P. Scherer Corp Chairman Alex Erdeljan said the impact of the strong U.S. dollar will reduce full year reported earnings by between $0.08 and $0.10 per share.
He did not give specific numbers. Officials from the company were not immediately available to comment.
Erdeljan also said the company's second-quarter results will be "at a minimum" in line with the current consensus forecast.
He added that the company expects to reach a double digit improvement in EPS for the first half of fiscal 1998.
